text:
Noah: hey everyone, excited to join! quick access Q: I can see Console read pages in staging but not the Admin > Feature Flags section in prod. need to bump a rollout percent for a short smoke. who should I ask?
Priya: welcome Noah! :wave: For prod flag writes we require a privileged action ticket. @Omar from platform usually approves day-1 low-risk toggles.
Noah: thanks Priya. my okta email is noah@redwood.ai — i do have staging admin.
Omar: hey — welcome aboard. confirm the flag name and expected window/percent. we try to keep TTLs small and prefer using scheduled toggles in the Console for auditability.
Noah: flag: assistant_ui_rollout, want 5% for 20m to validate a telemetry fix. will revert immediately if anything odd.
infra-bot: IAM check: noah@redwood.ai -> groups: console-read, eng-dev. Missing: console-admin (featureflag.modify). Prod admin changes require PRIV workflow. See https://docs.redwood.ai/security/privileged-actions
Noah: ok i can file whatever's needed. what's the ticket template?
ops-bot: PRIV workflow: create PRIV ticket with justification, include monitoring links + rollback steps. Max temporary grant = 2h, recommended <=30m for small tests. Template: "PRIV: <short desc> | flag: <name> | env: prod | ttl: <time> | monitoring: <links> | rollback: <steps>"
Noah: opened PRIV-92 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-92 — "temp prod toggle assistant_ui_rollout 5% (20m)". included logs and dashboards.
Omar: reviewed PRIV-92 and approved. tagging infra for grant.
infra-bot: initiating temp grant: `grant-temp-role --user=noah --role=console-admin --env=prod --ttl=00:30 --ticket=PRIV-92 --note="new-hire smoke test"`
infra-bot: grant complete. audit_id=aud-cc7b2. expires in 30m.
Noah: used the Console scheduled toggle UI (preferred) to set 5% for 20m. smoke runs started. thanks all!
Priya: nice. added a quick onboarding note: "If you need prod flag edits in week 1, open PRIV ticket early; include dashboards and TTL."
Omar: infra will auto-revoke in 30m, but ping if you need a manual revoke earlier.
Noah: tests passed, reverting to 0% now. all good. appreciate the quick help.
ops-bot: PRIV-92 logged in privileged-action history. retention: 1y.
